items.summary: Out since Week 1 after knee surgery, Garrett is ruled out against the Raiders but could return to practice the week of Oct. 26, with Week 8 against the Chargers possible.

items.headline: Bears TE Cole Kmet headed to injured reserve with a knee injury
items.summary: Ben Johnson called the right-knee injury serious and said Kmet will go on IR; reports say it is likely season-ending, pending tests.

items.headline: McDavid and Draisaitl each post five points as Oilers outlast Hurricanes 6–5 in a shootout
items.summary: Both stars had two goals and three assists; Edmonton scored three power-play goals and rallied with three in the third period.

items.headline: Sharks rout Senators 6–2 behind two shorthanded goals
items.summary: San Jose scored twice shorthanded and twice into an empty net despite being outshot 43–28; Yaroslav Askarov was named first star.

items.headline: Lucas Raymond scores twice as Red Wings beat Canucks 5–2
items.summary: Raymond had two goals and an assist on five shots, and Detroit outshot Vancouver 31–13.

items.headline: Shutouts in Pittsburgh and Boston
items.summary: The Penguins blanked the Panthers 4–0 and the Bruins beat the Predators 6–0.

items.headline: Flames edge Wild 2–1 despite being outshot 37–22
items.summary: Calgary scored twice on the power play in the first period; Matt Boldy had seven shots and Kirill Kaprizov four without scoring.

items.headline: Tonight: Kucherov one point from Lightning franchise record in Colorado
items.summary: Kucherov (1,137 points) is tied with Steven Stamkos for Tampa Bay's all-time lead, and MacKinnon is two points from 1,300 including playoffs. In Chicago, Ian Cole plays his 1,000th game as Bedard faces Montreal.

items.headline: Senators put Ullmark on injured reserve; Ersson starts against San Jose
items.summary: Linus Ullmark left Wednesday's win over Florida with a lower-body strain and is on IR. Samuel Ersson starts Thursday, and Jonas Johansson was recalled from Belleville to back him up.

items.headline: Jalen Hurts reportedly out for the season with blood clots
items.summary: The Eagles quarterback was reportedly diagnosed with deep vein thrombosis and clots in his lungs and is being treated with blood thinners. The NFLPA has called for a full investigation.

items.headline: Senators beat Panthers 5-1 in Brady Tkachuk's return to Ottawa
items.summary: Tkachuk scored a power-play goal in his first game back in Ottawa, but Tim Stutzle, Claude Giroux, Shane Pinto, Warren Foegele and Stephen Halliday all scored for the Senators.

items.headline: Baker Mayfield on track to return from thumb injury against Carolina
items.summary: Mayfield was a full participant in practice Wednesday and said his dislocated thumb is strong enough to play. He will wear a protective glove developed with input from the Tampa Bay Rays' staff.

items.headline: Canadiens captain Nick Suzuki out 2-4 weeks with a hand injury
items.summary: Montreal says Suzuki will miss two to four weeks. Kasperi Kapanen moved between Cole Caufield and Juraj Slafkovsky at practice.

items.headline: Cole Knuble scores twice as Flyers win 3-1 in Buffalo
items.summary: Knuble had two goals and Trevor Zegras added a power-play goal; Dan Vladar made 27 saves on 28 shots. Jason Zucker scored Buffalo's only goal.

items.headline: Patriots visit Bears on Thursday Night Football
items.summary: Drake Maye has no injury designation after a full practice. New England has ruled out cornerbacks Carlton Davis III, Channing Canada and Karon Prunty, and Chicago is without running back Kyle Monangai.

items.headline: Cooper Black to make his NHL debut as Markstrom misses 1-2 weeks
items.summary: Florida will start Black in Pittsburgh on the second night of a back-to-back. In Edmonton, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins makes his season debut against Carolina.

items.headline: Penguins put Bryan Rust and Ben Kindel on injured reserve
items.summary: Pittsburgh recalled Rutger McGroarty and Chase Pietila from Wilkes-Barre/Scranton. Ottawa's Thomas Chabot is expected to miss one to two weeks.

items.headline: 12-game Thursday slate, led by DeBrincat and Kaprizov
items.summary: Twelve games are on tonight. Detroit visits Vancouver, which allows a league-high 33.7 shots per game, and Minnesota plays in Calgary. Florida and Ottawa are both on the second night of back-to-backs.

items.headline: Dahlin and Zucker return as Buffalo hosts Philadelphia
items.summary: Captain Rasmus Dahlin is back after missing three games with an upper-body injury, and Jason Zucker makes his season debut after sports hernia surgery. Dahlin rejoins the top power-play unit.

items.headline: Sanderson returns for Ottawa against Brady Tkachuk and the Panthers
items.summary: Jake Sanderson plays after missing eight straight games and was paired with Artem Zub at the morning skate; Thomas Chabot remains out 1-2 weeks.

items.headline: Terry McLaurin out for the season with a torn patellar tendon
items.summary: Washington's top receiver tore his patellar tendon and will miss the rest of the year.

items.headline: Celebrini scores twice, including the overtime winner, as the Sharks rally past Montreal
items.summary: San Jose came back from 3-1 down in the third period and won 4-3 on Celebrini's power-play goal in OT. Caufield, Suzuki and Slafkovsky scored for the Canadiens.

items.headline: Mike Evans aggravates his Achilles; status for Sunday unclear
items.summary: Evans left Monday's win over Washington after 3 catches for 94 yards. Kyle Shanahan reportedly doesn't see it as a long-term issue, but his availability against Atlanta isn't confirmed.

items.headline: Rams lose Davante Adams for 6 to 10 weeks
items.summary: Adams ruptured a hamstring against Arizona and went on injured reserve. Kicker Blake Grupe (torn ACL) and DT Poona Ford (triceps) are out for the season; the Rams signed Brandon McManus.

items.headline: DeBrincat's 300th goal forces overtime, but Seattle wins in a shootout
items.summary: DeBrincat tied it 3-3 with 17 seconds left after Detroit trailed 3-0, then the Kraken won the shootout 4-3.

items.headline: Draisaitl's two power-play goals lift Edmonton over Minnesota in overtime
items.summary: The Oilers won 4-3; Kaprizov had a goal and an assist and Eriksson Ek put 8 shots on goal for the Wild.

items.headline: Lamar Jackson still day-to-day with his ankle
items.summary: Baltimore hasn't confirmed whether he'll face Cincinnati; Tyler Huntley has started the last two games.

items.headline: Two games tonight: Flyers at Sabres and Panthers at Senators
items.summary: Vladar, Luukkonen and Schmid are confirmed and Ullmark is likely; Ottawa's Ullmark (.945) is the best goalie on the slate.

items.headline: 49ers hold off Commanders 23-17 on Monday Night Football to stay unbeaten
items.summary: San Francisco led 20-3 at halftime and held on as Washington fell to 1-5. Mike Evans left late in the second quarter after a 94-yard first half.

items.headline: Commanders' Terry McLaurin suffers significant knee injury
items.summary: McLaurin was carted off in the first quarter after a non-contact left knee injury. ESPN's John Keim reports the injury is significant.

items.headline: Kaprizov and McDavid meet as Wild visit Oilers
items.summary: Kaprizov leads the NHL with 10 goals in nine games, and McDavid leads with 23 points. Minnesota is without Spurgeon and Gustavsson.

items.headline: Giants to release running back Najee Harris
items.summary: The move follows Harris publicly questioning his workload after a four-carry game against the Saints. He had 31 carries for 99 yards in five games with New York.

items.headline: Rams' Davante Adams expected to miss 6-10 weeks
items.summary: Sean McVay gave the timeline after Adams went down without contact in Sunday's loss to Arizona.

items.headline: Matthews scores and Leafs beat Sharks 3-1
items.summary: Matthews scored on the power play and assisted on Gavin McKenna's third-period winner. Bobrovsky made 30 saves.

items.headline: Michkov scores twice as Flyers edge Avalanche 3-2
items.summary: Matvei Michkov had a power-play goal and an even-strength goal, and Noel Acciari scored the winner. MacKinnon was held to one shot.

items.headline: Islanders lose Ritchie and Maccelli to lower-body injuries
items.summary: Calum Ritchie is out four to six weeks and Matias Maccelli two to four weeks, both hurt in the win at Toronto.

items.headline: Panthers goalie Jacob Markstrom out 1-2 weeks
items.summary: Markstrom was hurt in practice. Akira Schmid is expected to start Wednesday against Ottawa.

items.headline: Kucherov four points from Lightning record as Tampa visits Vegas
items.summary: Kucherov has 1,134 points and a point in all 42 career games against Vegas. Eichel has 18 points for the league-leading Golden Knights.

items.headline: Jalen Hurts reportedly out for the season with blood clots
items.summary: The Eagles quarterback is being treated with blood thinners for deep vein thrombosis and clots in his lungs, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter. The team and his agent released a joint statement on his treatment plan.

items.headline: Colts fire general manager Chris Ballard after loss to the Titans
items.summary: Indianapolis announced the move Monday, a day after a 26-20 loss to Tennessee. Coach Shane Steichen said Daniel Jones stays the starter despite two interceptions.

items.headline: Nylander questionable for Toronto against San Jose with an illness
items.summary: William Nylander (5 goals, 12 points in 9 games) missed the morning skate. Toronto is already without John Tavares, who is out week to week.

items.headline: Rams receiver Davante Adams leaves loss to Arizona with a knee injury
items.summary: Adams went out with an apparent left knee injury in the 18-16 loss to the Cardinals; the Rams have not given details.

items.headline: Chiefs move to 5-0 as Kenneth Walker runs for two touchdowns
items.summary: Walker ran for 128 yards in a 22-6 win over the Chargers, who fall to 0-6. Los Angeles played without Ladd McConkey (concussion).

items.headline: Falcons safety Kendal Daniels taken off on a stretcher with a neck injury
items.summary: Daniels left the loss to Chicago in the third quarter and went to hospital for evaluation. The team said he was alert and had movement in his extremities.

items.headline: Steelers erase a 13-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the Buccaneers in overtime
items.summary: Pittsburgh won 26-19 to reach 4-2 after two late interceptions by Tampa Bay's Jalon Daniels. The Buccaneers are 1-5.

items.headline: Unbeaten 49ers host the Commanders on Monday Night Football
items.summary: San Francisco (5-0) is a 7.5-point favourite with a total around 51. Washington is without Marcus Mariota and Jacory Croskey-Merritt, and Stefon Diggs is questionable.

items.headline: Kaprizov's power-play goal lifts the Wild past the Blue Jackets 2-1
items.summary: Minnesota outshot Columbus 34-14, with Matt Boldy putting six shots on goal. Adam Fantilli scored for Columbus.

items.headline: Flames end Carolina's seven-game winning streak with a 3-2 win
items.summary: Yegor Sharangovich scored the winner on six shots and Morgan Frost added a goal and an assist. Carolina outshot Calgary 36-34.

items.headline: Browns beat Ravens 13-10 on a last-second field goal
items.summary: Andre Szmyt hit a 37-yarder as time expired after Cleveland erased a 10-0 first-quarter hole. Derrick Henry ran for 58 yards and lost a fumble with Tyler Huntley at quarterback.

items.headline: Caleb Williams returns as Bears beat Falcons 31-23
items.summary: Williams completed 30 of 36 in his first game back from a hamstring injury, and D'Andre Swift ran for two touchdowns. Atlanta lost three fumbles.

items.headline: Patriots hold off Jets 26-19 for a third straight win
items.summary: Drake Maye threw three touchdowns as A.J. Brown returned from his ankle injury. Elsewhere, Carolina won 25-14 in Philadelphia and Tennessee beat Indianapolis 26-20 with a blocked-punt touchdown.

items.headline: Eagles place Jalen Hurts on injured reserve with a calf blood clot
items.summary: Hurts will miss at least four games, and Tanner McKee starts Sunday against Carolina. Philadelphia also ruled out guard Landon Dickerson and several others.

items.headline: Panthers rout Kraken 8-3 for a third straight game with a natural hat trick
items.summary: Carter Verhaeghe and Sam Bennett each scored three for Florida, a first in NHL history across three consecutive games. Elsewhere Saturday, McDavid had five points as Edmonton beat Utah 6-2.

items.headline: Broncos beat Seahawks 17-14 in overtime on Thursday night
items.summary: Wil Lutz won it with a 53-yard field goal after an interception. Nik Bonitto had five sacks as Denver won despite gaining only 168 yards.

items.headline: Lamar Jackson out again; Tyler Huntley starts at Cleveland
items.summary: Jackson misses a second straight game with an ankle injury. The 4-1 Ravens visit the 3-2 Browns at 1 p.m. ET.

items.headline: Maple Leafs lose John Tavares week-to-week
items.summary: Tavares was hurt in Thursday's overtime loss to Buffalo, and Chris Tanev is also week-to-week. Toronto lost 4-1 to the Islanders without him on Saturday.

items.headline: Caleb Williams expected to return for Bears against Falcons
items.summary: Williams has missed three games with a hamstring injury but practiced fully this week. Michael Penix Jr. is cleared to start for Atlanta.

items.headline: A.J. Brown activated by Patriots; 49ers rule out Bosa and Samuel for Monday
items.summary: New England activated Brown from his ankle injury for the Jets game. Unbeaten San Francisco will be without Nick Bosa and Deebo Samuel against Washington, which ruled out QB Marcus Mariota.
